chunks: Jābir narrated from Abī Jaʿfar عليه السلام that he said:
“There is no harm in the junub reciting the Talbiyah.”

key_terms.أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ: Abū Jaʿfar; the Imam transmitting the ruling
key_terms.الْجُنُبُ: a person in a state of major ritual impurity (janabah)
key_terms.رَوَى: narrated; indicates transmission of the hadith
key_terms.لَا بَأْسَ: there is no harm; a formula indicating permissibility
key_terms.يُلَبِّيَ: to recite the Talbiyah in the rites of hajj or ʿumrah

ai.seo_question: Can a person in a state of janabah recite the Talbiyah?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling that a person in the state of janabah may recite the Talbiyah. It indicates that this ritual utterance of hajj is not barred by major ritual impurity.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.2582 - Jabir narrated from Abu Ja'far (as) that he said:
"There is no harm in a junub (someone in a state of major ritual impurity) reciting the Talbiyah."
